Game mode

How to play

Drive & drift

Your car drives itself. Steer with ←→ or AD. On phones, slide your finger.

Tiles crumble

Every tile you touch takes your color and drops away, then comes back. Keep moving!

Jump & fly

SPACE or tap to jump. Press again in the air to open your wings and glide.

Smash rivals

Ram cars off the arena. Nitro gives speed, Rage gives huge knockbacks.
